title: After the Satsuki Sho: You're Strong

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the Satsuki Sho, Ines Fujin's increased awareness of the competition—and theirs of her—leaves her even more eager to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her determination lights a fire in me, and I promise to lead her to victory as the fan favorite at the Japanese Derby—a race that all Umamusume dream of entering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when Ines Fujin hears how much confidence I have in her, her desire to win grows stronger still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to thank me—for letting her keep working, for letting her aim for the Derby… and for helping her realize her own desires.
